title: Haunted Puzzle Pieces
description: Haunted Puzzle Pieces is a spooky jigsaw game with two challenging modes: 16 pieces and 32 pieces. Assemble eerie images piece by piece and enjoy a hauntingly fun puzzle experience. Can you complete the puzzles before the ghosts catch up?
instructions: Use your mouse or touchpad to drag and drop the puzzle pieces into place Complete the image by fitting all pieces together Choose between 16 or 32 pieces for your challenge
